title: Independent reach contacts and ring closure experiments
summary: Original standalone mathematical probes pass 3200 two-bone cases including unreachable and root-near targets with both bend signs; maximum tested length error 5.41e-14. Three support schedules pass 1200 samples each, constant-speed stance world drift below 3.56e-15 and contact join gap below 3.2e-6. 310 integer-turn ring point checks pass. Not integrated. No joint-angle collision COM stability raster art or device-performance proof.
